# Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan

One Microsoft Defender for Cloud plan on a subscription (`Microsoft.Security/pricings`). The root module
calls it for each entry of `defender_plans`; a separate state can call it alone:

```hcl
source = "git::https://github.com/fortytwoservices/az-tf-mlz-management.git//modules/defender_plan?ref=vX.Y.Z"
```

- **Not tested in Azure.** By decision, this is released without a sandbox test; the first customer
  deployment is its first test. `azapi_update_resource` does not validate its body against the AzAPI
  provider's schema, so the unit tests do, through an `azapi_resource` fixture (property names and types;
  the schema does not restrict the tier's values, which this module validates).
- Only what is set is managed: an unset `sub_plan` and the extensions not listed stay as Azure has them.
- A subscription's plans always exist, so the plan is updated in place (`azapi_update_resource`):
  `tier = "Free"` turns it off, and removing it from the configuration leaves Azure as it is (still on,
  if it was). Turn it off first, then remove it.
- A Standard plan bills every protected resource in the subscription.
- With the Azure landing zone policies, give each plan one owner: this module, or the
  `Deploy-MDFC-Config-H224` assignment's `enableAscFor*` parameters (`Disabled` by default), not both.
- No lock: a lock at subscription scope would lock the whole subscription.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the Defender plan (the pricing), for example `VirtualMachines`, `SqlServers`, `StorageAccounts`, `KeyVaults`, `Containers`, `CloudPosture`.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the subscription the plan applies to, for example `/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`.

Type: `string`

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_extensions"></a> [extensions](#input\_extensions)

Description: Extensions of the plan, keyed by extension name, for example `AgentlessVmScanning` or
`SensitiveDataDiscovery`. Only the extensions listed are managed: the others, and one removed from this  
map, stay as Azure has them. Defaults to none.

- `enabled` - Whether the extension is on.
- `additional_properties` - (Optional) The extension's additional properties, for example `{ ExclusionTags = "[]" }`. Unset, Azure's stand.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    enabled               = bool
    additional_properties = optional(map(string))
  }))
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: Override the AzAPI `<provider>/<resource>@<api-version>` strings used by this module. Each key defaults to a tested value; supply only the keys you want to override.

- `security_pricings` - The Defender plan (pricing).

Type:

```hcl
object({
    security_pricings = optional(string, "Microsoft.Security/pricings@2024-01-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration applied to every `azapi` resource managed by the module. Defaults to `null` (no custom retry).

- `error_message_regex`  - (Optional) A list of regex patterns matching error messages that trigger a retry.
- `interval_seconds`     - (Optional) Initial interval between retries in seconds.
- `max_interval_seconds` - (Optional) Maximum interval between retries in seconds.

See <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Azure/azapi/latest/docs/resources/update_resource#retry> for full semantics.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string))
    interval_seconds     = optional(number)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number)
  })
```

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_sub_plan"></a> [sub\_plan](#input\_sub\_plan)

Description: (Optional) Sub-plan of a Standard plan, where the plan has more than one, for example `P1` or `P2` for `VirtualMachines`. Defaults to `null`: not sent, so Azure's sub-plan stands (the full plan for a new one); setting it back to `null` leaves the last one in place.

Type: `string`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_tier"></a> [tier](#input\_tier)

Description: `Standard` turns the plan on (billed per protected resource); `Free` turns it off. Defaults to `Standard`.

Type: `string`

Default: `"Standard"`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Default per-operation timeouts applied to every `azapi` resource managed by the module. Defaults to `null` (provider defaults). Each value is a Go duration string (e.g. `30m`, `1h`).

- `create` - (Optional) Timeout for create operations.
- `read`   - (Optional) Timeout for read operations.
- `update` - (Optional) Timeout for update operations.
- `delete` - (Optional) Timeout for delete operations.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string)
    read   = optional(string)
    update = optional(string)
    delete = optional(string)
  })
```

Default: `null`
